item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a storm, Ekta sees a bright flash of lightning and soon hears thunder. Inside the storm cloud, strong winds make water droplets and ice particles rub against each other.

Which sequence correctly describes how lightning and thunder are produced?

options.A: Rubbing separates charges; the charge buildup breaks down the insulating property of air; a sudden discharge gives lightning; rapid heating and expansion of air gives thunder.
options.B: Thunder is produced first; the sound of thunder then separates the charges and forms lightning.
options.C: Rubbing separates charges and lightning flashes even when the charge buildup is too small to break down the insulating property of air.
options.D: Ice particles alone separate the charges; water droplets play no part in the sequence.
